title: The Question Comes First

criteria.name: Hook & retention
criteria.notes: The opening 19-contact cue and NEXT STEP notebook establish a concrete unanswered question immediately. The extra page at 93.14s and separate-person test at 107.78s pay the two plants. The 13.72 to 28.68s announcement/funding/training passage is comparatively administrative: several mounting labels give it less escalating interest than the mechanism and archive scenes. The return of the pencil at 118.94s supplies a real closing question.

criteria.name: Illustration craft & detail
criteria.notes: The notebook has stacked paper edges, stitching, dog-ears, paper ruling, contact shadows and distinct coral tabs; the 33.9s array has exactly 19 layered scalp contacts, shaded ribs and a supported display. Sleeves and hands carry highlight/shadow treatment consistent with the props. The reading book at 61.3s and test holders at 112.6s have simpler broad interior fills and fewer material cues than the hero notebook, so finish is clean but not uniformly at its richest level.

criteria.name: Motion & animation craft
criteria.notes: All 40 sequential motion strips and all 7 supplemental action grids were inspected. The 16.03 to 17.10s lab label has a visible approach and seating; 32.23 to 34.37s points to a fixed contact without moving the hardware; 88.10 to 90.77s compares two inventory contexts; 93.13 to 93.93s unfolds the new wing; 107.80 to 108.60s moves the person exclusively into TEST. Page blur, rotations, finger/hand approaches and secondary ribbon/strap life are present. Several hand/tab beats, especially 44.66 to 51.03s and 99.62s, share a short horizontal placement and a nearly held follow-through. More varied release, reaction and settling would raise performance beyond the current competent choreography; this is not a demand for a different render style.

criteria.name: Composition & staging
criteria.notes: Full master frames preserve a clear centered story zone and keep labels and captions separate. The 33.9s contact-to-display relationship and 112.6s TRAINING/TEST separation read well. At 88 to 92s the inventory pages, question cards, large schematic trace and persistent notebook all occupy closely stacked planes; it remains readable but the little source pages and notebook lose visual priority. The repeated window, header and lower ledge make the 14 scenes feel spatially less varied than their changing subjects. The square crop is outside this aesthetic score.

criteria.name: Color & grade
criteria.notes: The lilac daylight, ivory paper, deep violet ink, citron tasks and coral tabs form a fresh, coherent laboratory/notebook world. The bright accent is reserved for contacts and planning markers, while shading and restrained vignette preserve depth without muddying labels. This is visibly distinct from the preserved September 11 spruce/plum/cream reference, and the storyboard documents the comparison with the recent glacier episode. No palette blocker observed.

criteria.name: Typography & captions
criteria.notes: Headlines, monospaced document labels and dark-band captions are crisp in the full master stills. Long funding/training captions remain readable at 24.2s, and schematic/planned qualifiers remain visible in the mechanism and study scenes. The 220 aligned cues pass the current caption checks. At 106 to 113s the headline and two full-width label bars repeat the conditional framing in close succession; this is legible but text-heavy and less elegant than the opening hierarchy. Credits at 130.7s are readable and include the composer and license.

criteria.name: Sound design & mix
criteria.notes: The current master measurement is -14.67 LUFS, -3.04 dBTP and 6.9 LU LRA, with passing AAC and audio reports. The evidence records 40 motivated events across 12 kinds, 23 verified audible event lifts, a real pre-question bed dip at 118.19s, and credited Life of Riley by Kevin MacLeod. The cue map supplies paper, hinge, seating and pencil motifs tied to picture actions, with a restrained reveal accent at 93.14s. This score is based on measured mix and the current cue/mix evidence; I did not listen to the audio and do not assert a heard tonal or performance defect.

criteria.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
criteria.notes: The 19-contact opening, the highlighted scalp contact at 32 to 34s, the independent planned gaze marker at 65.25s, the useful existing-recording comparison at 81.83s, the unfolding collection/test workspace at 93.14s and the held-out-person action at 107.78s all align with the relevant spoken ideas and caption text. The diagram does more than restate headlines. The explanatory hands and label placements at 44.66 to 51.03s are watchable but offer less characterful surprise than the notebook reveal. Audio timing is supported by alignment evidence rather than a listening claim.

criteria.name: Accuracy & sourcing
criteria.notes: The current claims, primary-source ledger and independent fact-check support acquisition, September 9th announcement, Educational Legacy Fund, training, Egorov, hardware and future reading/programming plans. The literal array counts 19, while two earclips and three auxiliary sockets stay visually distinct. SCHEMATIC, PLANNED, GENERAL METHODS EXAMPLE and NO UAA RESULT qualifiers prevent invented outcomes; the new-person test is explicitly conditional. Public recordings retain a useful route before optional collection. The acquisition and study-plan details ultimately rely on the institutional announcement, so this is strong transparent primary sourcing rather than two independent confirmations of every announcement fact. No factual hard blocker found.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
criteria.notes: UAA, its lab, its funding and its student research capacity remain the story throughout. It treats the local acquisition as a useful win without inventing clinical efficacy, broad community endorsement or a need for outsiders to rescue Alaska. The generic student depiction and ordinary laboratory imagery avoid unverified cultural symbols. The 113 to 118s return to UAA PLANNED pages carefully keeps the general method example separate from the university record.

criteria.name: Writing & post quality
criteria.notes: The VO and post have a concrete opening, plain explanations, correct future tense for the studies, contractions and a genuine final research question. The post makes the own-task collection advantage clear while crediting the ongoing value of public datasets; its four tail hashtags suit the Dispatch surface. The sentence about the Educational Legacy Fund repeats fund/funded audibly in the script, and the 69 to 105s run revisits plans, old pages and the interpretation boundary several times. These are minor economy/polish issues, not factual or brand violations.

one_sentence_fix: Vary the short hand-and-tab placements around 44.66 to 51.03s and 99.62s with a clearer release, prop reaction and settle so those actions have more distinct performances.
rationale: A coherent, legible, responsibly sourced research story with an earned notebook payoff and a clear conditional test example; execution clears the current within-style ship bar, while repeated small placement gestures limit its animation range.
calibration_scope: Inspected the five preserved September 11 reference images and all three unchanged historical cards. Those are whole-film historical scores, not separately scored stills or an owner-approved target. The current film was independently scored within the flat-vector IGS 2.5D style. No current peer judge card or requested change list was inspected.
evidence_scope: Current 9:16 master only. Independently hashed the master and matched both final-taste and supplemental-action receipts. Viewed all four whole-film taste sheets (42 still samples), all forty full-frame sequential strips, all seven supplemental sequential action grids and eight representative full-resolution stills including the credits. Sound was assessed through current measurements/cue/mix reports, not direct listening. The square is a separate mechanical crop check and is not aesthetically scored here.
